show_structures.label: Render Buildings
show_structures.description: Toggles whether buildings are rendered on top of the terrain.

ground_snap.label: Ground Altitude Lock
ground_snap.description: Constrains the camera focus altitude to the actual terrain height while panning.

show_debug_objects.label: Debug Gizmos
show_debug_objects.description: Displays coordinate markers (map centers, tile boundaries) for debugging purposes.

show_ledger.label: Scheduler Ledger
show_ledger.description: Corner panel showing frame pacing, GPU load, fetch-queue depth and task latency from the world scheduler, with the report, trace and console-log buttons.

pixel_dither.label: LOD cross-fade (per pixel)
pixel_dither.description: Dissolves between LOD tiers with overlapping dither patterns instead of switching a whole chunk at once. Only the three nearest thresholds (192/384/768) blend at all. Draws blending chunks twice, and the pattern crawls without temporal AA.

dummy_toast.label: Test Toast Notifications
dummy_toast.description: Displays sample toast notifications for UI testing.
